title: Auto Opener Inventory Farm ShadowHub
features:
Experience the fastest case opening for Case Paradise. ShadowHub fully automates your inventory growth by opening thousands of cases in seconds. Includes an intelligent auto-sell system to keep your inventory clean and high-value.

Main Features:
⚡ Speed Opener: Open cases at the maximum possible game speed.
💰 Auto Sell: Automatically sells junk items based on your rarity settings.
📊 Inventory Stats: Real-time tracking of your rarest pulls.
🛡️ Anti-AFK: Built-in protection so you never get kicked while opening.
🏃 Movement: Custom WalkSpeed and JumpPower modifiers.
